limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

findings.text: [Q01](#research-q01) 在DSH会话内反复查改文件、核Git和独立追问的开发者，需知道真实目录、变更与支线结果，而不只是打开工作台。
[Q02](#research-q02) 会话/workingDirectory/worktree解析后保存，按可选mtime拒绝冲突并temp替换；[Q03](#research-q03) Host准入与词法路径分层；[Q04](#research-q04) Git实际本地/远端命令；[Q05](#research-q05) 可注销扩展与真实Agent子会话。

根插件代表链：版本/Host与client入口、当前会话/worktree文件保存、词法路径/准入、常见Git写及push/pull和可选LLM草稿、扩展tab/viewer、侧聊create/resume/cancel/dispose及Host terminal关闭callee。未全审所有文件操作/viewer/task/team/workflow/媒体/外部插件和完整Host服务。前稿七题与全部findings重核。
原生DSH Host+web插件0.30.1/MIT，Node>=20，多Host peer^0.2.2-rc.1；分块客户端和可选服务使实际发行包/Host兼容仍待验，不以README生态数量作采用结果。

| 阶段 | 现金与资源 | 人工与状态责任 |
|---|---|---|
| 首次 | Host/存储资源未知 | 核版本、分块资源、profile和备份；分钟未知 |
| 持续 | 轮询/连接、shell、可选侧聊和LLM token费未知 | 核目录、Git与支线结果，节时未测 |
| 失败恢复 | 追加模型/Git/存储资源未知 | mtime竞态、部分sync、持久线程需人工核 |
| 退出 | 已发生远端/模型用量是否可退未核 | 草稿/文件/索引、shell/Agent/历史分开处理 |
[Q06](#research-q06) 先固定Host版本与低权限副本，核实际cwd/path再单文件保存；Git从只读开始，远端/模型动作另确认。用小预算虚构侧聊核持久化和keepInbox/dispose区别，退出核shell/Agent与已写字节；[Q07](#research-q07)路径能力候选先做对照。

| 效果项 | 当前源码支持 | 尚不支持 |
|---|---|---|
| 会话保存 | 当前目录回退与条件mtime/temp替换 | 目录授权/所有并发无损 |
| Git | 实际argv与UI错误/刷新 | 统一二次确认、远端回滚 |
| 扩展 | 重复ID拒绝/原对象注销 | 全生态与热重载可靠性 |
| 侧聊/terminal | 真实Agent/Host终端接线与不同关闭语义 | 工具完成、低成本、无残留 |
| 采用 | 低权限副本试用可设计 | IDE对照净收益与长期价值 |
[Q02](#research-q02)保存保留检测格式、条件mtime与独占temp有具体边界；[Q03](#research-q03)原生Host准入不等于真实路径围栏；[Q04](#research-q04)部分sync与[Q05](#research-q05)registry/sidechat/terminal生命周期不同，不以功能清单或测试文件数证明可靠性。
[Q02](#research-q02) 至 [Q05](#research-q05) 的增量是会话/工作树与编辑、Git和可注销扩展服务接线，并让侧聊成为继承上下文、独立继续且持久的子会话；保存条件冲突与registry按原对象注销给具体局部防护。上下文并置有维护价值，但不是目录沙箱、动作全确认或运行可靠性证据。
[Q03](#research-q03) 会话目录不是权限围栏，已获准请求可达Host OS权限范围；[Q04](#research-q04) push/pull等并无统一二次确认，partial sync不回滚；[Q05](#research-q05) 关面板/取消/释放Agent不等于删除历史或终止shell。若用户据“会话工作台”误判隔离与退出，损失可能大于少切窗口的便利。
[Q07](#research-q07) 提议按真实目标与操作类别提供可审查、可撤销的单次写/远端能力，区分已提交与可回退状态；对照当前工作台+备份，在链接/切会话/mtime竞争/partial sync中核落点、误拒绝和恢复分钟，若阻合法工作或仍越界就推翻。候选尚未实现验收。

| 依赖 | 作用 | 版本或条件 |
|---|---|---|
| Better Sidebar | 本插件 | 0.30.1，MIT；Node>=20，pnpm11.8.0 |
| DSH核心与client | Host/会话/原生surface | 多peer ^0.2.2-rc.1；Cordis^4.0.5，React/DOM^18.2.0 |
| webServer/sessions/connection/tools | Host挂载 | 实际必需inject；具体部署准入另核 |
| Git与账号权限 | 本地/远端仓库操作 | 正确repo和凭据；Host OS可达范围非cwd围栏 |
| agents/persistence/preset/模型 | 侧聊和可选LLM草稿 | 按功能需要；继承上下文可能有费用/资料外发 |
| Host webTerminals | 底部shell | 可选，缺能力不启动，内部停止未验 |

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)到[Q05](#research-q05)：novelty9为成熟编辑/Git/Host子Agent与扩展registry组合的有限新增，超过无适配0；没有新编码或版本控制方法到18。mechanism15以条件mtime、当前workingDirectory、按原descriptor注销及继承inbox清理改变局部正确性取舍，超薄入口8；无真实路径授权且stat/rename分开、取消非回滚，未解决直接替代关键安全约束到23。transferability10的可注销tab/viewer与子会话继承组织可供其他Host扩展借鉴，超过本页面私有5；强DSH事件/布局/会话格式耦合且外部消费者未验，不到15。simplification8用同一registry服务内置/外部与原生/底部载体，同时继承HostAgent/PTY减少重复运行层，超过局部入口4；多服务/分块/恢复复杂度未达到11。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q05](#research-q05)：workflow9依据真实侧聊start/create/inject/followup，将主线参考与独立继续问题分为持久子线程并保留队列，不只是把按钮搬到侧栏，超过无任务组织变化0；直接替代是另开Agent会话/手工复制上下文，未形成分派/复核责任闭环到18。delivery8把支线问答保存在独立可续子会话，并伴文件/Git结果定位，超过单一展示0；编码/仓库交付仍同类且没有质量验收改变，不到15。reach0既有DSH/IDE用户已有文件与会话入口，未识别此前明确受技能/环境限制人群，未到5。economics0核HostPTY/模型/Git复用，仍同用户提供凭据、算力和恢复劳动，侧聊可能增token，未识别供给/计价/资源或服务责任结构改变到4；未测费用独立列缺口。

recommendation.reason: 经常在 DSH 会话和文件间切换、能核目录与备份的开发者，可在匹配 0.2.2-rc.1 的低权限宿主和可丢弃仓库先试读取、单文件编辑与只读 Git。它把会话目录、编辑、Git 和可续侧聊接在一起，比手工复制上下文多一些组织接线，但目录范围、远端动作和后台会话仍需分别核实。路径、宿主准入或取消后状态不明就停并回到 IDE/终端，先保存草稿、查已写文件并关闭不需的 shell/Agent，强项目隔离需求先观察。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)会话查改/核Git/支线与[Q02](#research-q02)实际目录回退、[Q05](#research-q05)上下文复制摩擦形成具体重复任务，适合能承担核目录者，超一般明确用途15；没有同用户需求频次/重要性对照，不到30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)当前会话/worktree保存、[Q05](#research-q05)可注销registry和真实可续支线相对IDE+手动另开Agent有可解释接线增量，超过纯UI入口6；[Q03](#research-q03)目录无围栏与[Q04](#research-q04)非回滚远端使收益仍需验证，不到19。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)客户端→Host→writer、[Q04](#research-q04)UI→API→实际git/LLM与失败、[Q05](#research-q05)create/resume/cancel/dispose与registry均核，超片段声明6；限定代表链未运行Host/目标代码/模型/Git或效果，不到19。

cost.rationale: [Q06](#research-q06)低权限副本、备份和IDE退路提供有限控制，超无可行恢复0；[Q03](#research-q03)广OS路径、[Q04](#research-q04)远端与[Q05](#research-q05)持久子会话/shell需逐项清理，缺完整恢复/退出及费用数据，不到10。

publication.summaries.text: 在 DSH 会话中提供文件、编辑、Git 与侧聊工作台，并开放扩展页与预览器接口。

items.界面: 会话内文件/编辑/Git与侧聊、底部工作台。
items.Host 路由: 经Host原生准入调用文件保存、Git和侧聊操作。
items.后台: 使用Host Agent、模型和终端，提供可注销tab/viewer扩展服务。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 文件/编辑器 | 会话内读写目标文件 | 可选mtime；无工作区包含围栏 |
| Git工作台 | 查看、暂存、提交、分支与远端同步 | 部分动作直接执行；远端需单独授权 |
| 扩展registry | 内置/外部tab及viewer注册注销 | Host强耦合；消费者未验 |
| 可续侧聊 | 继承参考上下文，独立Agent继续 | accepted非完成，cancel保队列/历史 |
| 底部terminal | 同会话附加shell界面 | Host提供PTY；view卸载不停止进程 |

publication.advice.text: [Q06](#research-q06) 先固定Host版本与低权限副本，核实际cwd/path再单文件保存；Git从只读开始，远端/模型动作另确认。用小预算虚构侧聊核持久化和keepInbox/dispose区别，退出核shell/Agent与已写字节；[Q07](#research-q07)路径能力候选先做对照。

playsinline controls width=\"100%\"></video>\n</div>\n\n## ✨ Features\n\n| | |\n|---|---|\n| **🗂️ File Management**<br/>Lazy-loading tree, git status colors, live directory watch, global search, drag-and-drop upload, multi-select batch actions, dual-source \"Open with\" menu.<br/><img alt=\"File tree with git colors\" src=\"./docs/screenshots/files-tree.png\" /><br/><img alt=\"Context menu: Open with + Zip and download\" src=\"./docs/screenshots/files-menu-openwith.png\" /> | **🌿 Git**<br/>Source Control (Merge / Staged / Changes groups, message box with Generate, branch + sync footer) plus a this-session AI-changes lens, with a **read-only commit graph** (lanes, branch and tag badges, branch filter, commit details) in one tab.<br/><img alt=\"Git: changes and commit graph with tags\" src=\"./docs/screenshots/changes-tree.png\" /> |\n| **📝 Editable Editor & Previews**<br/>An editable CodeMirror (the stock preview is read-only), Markdown + Mermaid + floating outline, sandboxed HTML preview, `.jsonl` record cards, paged preview for huge files, streaming transfers with no size caps.<br/><img alt=\"Markdown + Mermaid preview\" src=\"https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fe0e5182-55bb-45cc-b98b-a2877c2bdd38\" /> | **🧩 Tasks**<br/>Live subagent topology (workflow graph / tree modes) + background task list: exit codes, live output, force-kill.<br/><img alt=\"Tasks: subagent topology\" src=\"https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dcd8ed2f-59fa-405b-937b-2d250f5034dd\" /> |\n| **💬 Side Chat (beta)**<br/>Codex-style side threads: inherit the full parent context and run independently, realtime push, visible & revocable queue, per-thread model selection, one-click promotion to a top-level session.<br/><img alt=\"Side Chat\" src=\"https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3a338c36-f5de-4000-95f3-4b1cd04f60fc\" /> | **🖥️ Bottom Workbench**<br/>A self-drawn bottom panel that coexists with the native right sidebar: drag-to-split panes, multiple terminal tabs, per-session persisted layout.<br/><img alt=\"Dual workbench\" src=\"https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dfdb875e-a1a8-4d4b-8340-353736b1708f\" /> |\n\n**Also**: 📂 the `sidebar_open` tool lets the model open the sidebar itself · ⚡ ~325KB core at startup, heavy chunks load on demand · 🌏 i18n follows DSH · 📱 narrow screens switch to a full-width drawer\n\n### 🌿 Git Graph (read-only commit graph)\n\nSwitch to **Git Graph** at the top of the Git panel for commit nodes, forks and merge edges across local branches, remote-tracking branches and HEAD. The branch selector only filters history — it **never checks out or fetches**; each commit is one line (lane edges + ref pills + subject), hover shows the author and short hash, and selecting one opens its full message and diff in the bottom pane. History loads in pages; reference changes during pagination prompt a refresh; reads are bounded (200 commits per page, offset 10,000, 1,000 branches) and report an explicit error past a limit. Lightweight and annotated tags appear on commits in the graph, rows and details use neutral tag pills, and tag changes invalidate pagination. Tag decorations keep the first 5,000 tags by ref name, further bounded by an 8 MiB complete-line output prefix; excess tags are omitted without failing the graph.\n\n### 🧭 dsh-context diagnostics (optional)\n\nWith the `dsh-context` plugin installed, three places offer a one-click jump into that conversation's **Context** view: an agent node's detail card on the Tasks page, a background job's output window (the job's real owner session — never merely the session its row was watched under), and the session header. The entries **appear only** while dsh-context's `Context` page is actually registered: a deployment without it (or with that page hidden) shows no control at all, and while one jump is in flight every entry point is disabled. A failed jump is reported once, in a dismissible alert at the frame's bottom edge; nothing is polled while idle.\n\n## 🚀 Installation\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar@latest\n```\n\nThen **hard-refresh the browser** (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R). Requires DSH **0.2.2-rc.1+**.\n\n> **Compatibility warning — match the plugin to the host line.** As of 2026-11-04, DSH's npm `latest` is **0.2.1-rc.5** and `next` is **0.2.2-rc.1**. **v0.30.0 requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+**; hosts on the 0.2.1 line (**0.2.1-rc.1 ~ rc.5**, i.e. today's `latest`) must pin `dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.2` — v0.29.0 was never published to npm. DSH 0.2.1-alpha.5 users must pin `dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0-alpha.0`, and hosts still on **0.2.0-rc.2** must pin `dsh-better-sidebar@0.26.1`. A 0.x caret never spans a minor version, so one plugin build cannot serve two host lines. The marketplace installer picks the plugin's `latest` regardless of host version, so an old host gets a version-rejection error — upgrade the host or pin the version explicitly. The two packages' `latest` tags are independent.\n\n<details>\n<summary><b>Pick the plugin version for your DSH version</b></summary>\n\n| Your DSH version | Install command |\n| --- | --- |\n| **0.2.2-rc.1+** | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar@0.30.1` |\n| **0.2.1-rc.1 ~ 0.2.1-rc.5** | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.2` |\n| **0.2.1-alpha.5** | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0-alpha.0` |\n| **0.2.0-rc.2** | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar@0.26.1` |\n| **0.2.0-rc.1** | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar@0.24.1` |\n| **0.1.7-rc.1 ~ 0.1.7 stable** | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar@0.22.1` |\n| 0.1.7-alpha.x | No compatible release — upgrade DSH to rc.1 first |\n| 0.1.6 and earlier (incl. the 0.1.5 line) | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar@0.19.1` |\n\nAlways pin **exact versions** for older releases (`latest` moves forward with each new stable). Replace `web` with your own profile name.\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><b>Other ways to install</b></summary>\n\n**Let DSH install it for you** — paste this prompt into any DSH session:\n\n```text\nInstall the dsh-better-sidebar plugin (a sidebar workbench for DSH):\n1. Confirm DSH is 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer, then run dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar@0.30.1\n2. Remind me to hard-refresh the browser (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R) afterwards\nIf something fails, check the FAQ table in https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar README first.\n```\n\n**One-line script** — clone this repo and run `bash scripts/install.sh 0.30.1` (macOS / Linux / Windows Git Bash; `./scripts/install.ps1 -Version 0.30.1` for native Windows). It handles installation + bundle registration.\n\n**Updating**: just re-run the install command, then hard-refresh the browser.\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><b>FAQ</b></summary>\n\n| Symptom | Cause & fix |\n|---|---|\n| `Ignored build scripts` error | pnpm 11 blocked a transitive dependency's build script. Run `pnpm approve-builds` in the profile directory (`~/.dsh/profiles/web`) — this plugin itself has no build-script dependencies. |\n| `minimum release age` / version younger than 24h | The release is less than 24 hours old. Wait 24h or re-run (pnpm auto-adds `minimumReleaseAgeExclude`). |\n| \"Profile directory not found\" | Run `dsh web` once to initialize `~/.dsh/profiles/web`. |\n| Host dies on start: `DesktopHostFatalError: … required plugins did not activate / better-sidebar` | The profile carries its own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` copies (left by an older DSH, or listed in the profile's `package.json` / overrides) and they resolve ahead of the installation, so the `dsh-subagent` this plugin imports statically binds to a mixed set; when an export is missing the host only reports this fatal and never names the package. Confirm with the check shipped in the current plugin: `node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-better-sidebar/scripts/check-profile-host-tree.mjs ~/.dsh/profiles/web`. Fix: remove `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` from the profile's `package.json` / overrides and `pnpm install` there (the installation then supplies them), or align both copies to one version; then restart. The install scripts run this check for you. |\n| **Two sidebars** on the page | Double mounting. Remove the legacy manual mount line (`- insert: ... better-sidebar ...`) from `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`; aggregate packages mounting this package under a different id are auto-yielded, no action needed. |\n| Settings values gone after upgrade | Since DSH 0.1.7, preferences live on this plugin's mount row in the profile (default entry id `better-sidebar`). The plugin migrates your old `settings.yaml` values once on first start and never overwrites newer values. |\n| Terminal unavailable | Terminals are provided by **DSH itself** (this plugin ships no PTY) — see DSH docs; \"host provides no terminal capability\" in the bottom terminal means this deployment has no terminal controller mounted. |\n| `dsh: command not found` | Install DSH first; or use `npx -y --package @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar@0.30.1`. |\n\n</details>\n\n## 🆕 Recent Updates\n\n**v0.30.1 — settings nav icon fix**\n\n- **The \"Side card\" row in Settings no longer shows two icons.** The plugin used to paint its own glyph over the shell's fallback gear with a CSS mask; the shell now wraps the nav icon in a container and exposes a per-section icon slot. The row contributes its icon through that slot, and the stale marker + CSS apparatus is gone — along with a document-wide DOM observer.\n\n**v0.30.0 — DSH 0.2.2 support, side-chat images, clickable quote chips**\n\n- **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 is the new baseline** (all 14 peer floors move to `^0.2.2-rc.1`). The host replaced the installable model-selection ref with an agent-owned `AgentModel`, so a side-chat thread's model switch now goes through `agent.model.select()` — recorded once in the log and applied to the next step. A 0.x caret never spans a minor: DSH 0.2.1 hosts (today's npm `latest`) keep pinning plugin v0.28.2.\n- **Side Chat takes images**: paste a screenshot or pick PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF, preview or remove before sending, or send images alone; the preview survives a reload and a cold restore.\n- **Quote chips are clickable**: a passage selected with \"Add to conversation\" lands as a chip that jumps back to the source file and flashes the quoted lines, with a nonce so a second click jumps again; if the reference record cannot be persisted the plugin falls back to the previous built-in chip instead of landing a dead one.\n- **Drafts survive the host-owned close paths**: closing a native sidebar tab or quitting the desktop app keeps the unsaved draft and offers it back when the same file is reopened — the host exposes no cancellable close hook, so this is backup-and-restore rather than a prompt.\n- **Reliability**: a side-chat seed built from a compacted parent no longer persists an unreadable session log; page CSS zoom is no longer misread as a page transform; the bottom workbench terminal no longer paints black; container workspaces show every child repository in the Git panel; the installers refuse a profile whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` copies are a mixed version pair and print the repair command.\n\n**v0.29.0 — GenUI in side chats**\n\n- Adds the opt-in `registerSidechatSurfaceAdapter` service for GenUI 0.15.0. Settled assistant replies can render interactive components, with actions and state kept in the owning child thread.\n- Uninstalled consumers, streaming replies and unsupported fences retain the existing Markdown view. The 0.28.2 cold-session read fix remains included.\n- Provider contribution: [@sunxiuguo](https://github.com/sunxiuguo), [#1033](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar/pull/1033).\n\n## 🔌 Plugin Ecosystem\n\n`ctx.betterSidebar` offers two extension points to every plugin — `registerTab` / `registerFileViewer`; the built-in 6 tabs + 4 viewers use the very same API.       "content": "/**\n * Follow the linked git worktree a session is ACTUALLY working in.\n *\n * The explorer starts from the host's committed workingDirectory, which can\n * change independently of the immutable header. It can also follow a linked\n * git worktree (`git worktree add`)\n * during its life  including a worktree of a repository that is not the one\n * the current directory points at  and the sidebar should follow it.\n *\n * The active root is derived from the session's own `tool/call` arguments:\n * absolute paths are collected newest-event-first (structured `cwd` / `workdir`\n * / `path` / ... fields weigh more than free-form mentions, repeated mentions\n * accumulate), each path's git top level is resolved with\n * `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` (falling back to its directory for files),\n * and only top levels whose `--absolute-git-dir` differs from their\n * `--git-common-dir` (i.e. real LINKED worktrees, not the main checkout and\n * not submodules) are adopted. A linked worktree that sits INSIDE the session\n * workspace is adopted only when it belongs to the SAME repository — a\n * `git worktree add .worktrees/x` of the session's own repo is the session\n * moving, while a nested repository's worktree is ordinary content of the\n * workspace: re-rooting the explorer into it hides every sibling directory\n * (#952). Outside the workspace any linked worktree is adopted, which is PR\n * #802's cross-repository case. The highest-scoring adoptable worktree of the\n * newest event that has one wins, but only evidence after the last committed\n * working-directory/change is eligible.       "content": "/**\n * Built-in registration: the plugin registers its own tab pages and file\n * previewers through the same {@link BetterSidebarService} external plugins\n * use — eating its own dogfood. The descriptors live next to their feature\n * modules (tabs.tsx / viewers.tsx); this module only aggregates them and\n * owns the disposer lifecycle (cordis auto-invokes it on fiber disposal,\n * HMR-safe).\n */\nimport type { Context } from '../../context-types.ts'\nimport type { BetterSidebarService } from '../service.ts'\nimport { builtinTabs } from './tabs.tsx'\nimport { builtinViewers } from './viewers.tsx'\n\n/**\n * Register all built-in tabs and viewers with the service. Returns a\n * disposer that unregisters everything (cordis auto-invokes it on fiber\n * disposal). The `ctx` is threaded into the descriptor factory that needs it\n * (the bottom terminal's `onClose` probes `ctx.webTerminals` to end the host\n * process; components read `ctx.betterSidebar` from their props).\n */\nexport function registerBuiltins(\n  ctx: Context,\n  service: BetterSidebarService,\n): () => void {\n  const disposers: (() => void)[] = []\n  for (const tab of builtinTabs(ctx)) {\n    disposers.push(service.registerTab(tab))\n  }\n  for (const viewer of builtinViewers()) {\n    disposers.push(service.registerFileViewer(viewer))\n  }\n  return () => {\n    for (const d of disposers) {\n      try { d() } catch { /* already disposed */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * The plugin's structural read of the HOST's browser terminal service\n * (`ctx.webTerminals`, provided by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-terminal-controller`'s\n * client half on the web profile).\n *\n * The plugin does NOT own a PTY stack any more (v0.21.1 yielded the terminal to\n * DSH's own right-Sidebar type): the bottom workbench's terminal drives the\n * host's session-scoped terminals through this service, and the host keeps\n * process lifetime, screen recovery and reconnection.\n *\n * Detection is STRUCTURAL and by name only — the plugin never imports the host\n * package (the client-bundle purity gate forbids `@deepseek-ai/*` value\n * imports outside the platform module table), and `webTerminals` is\n * deliberately NOT in `package.json#dsh.client.inject`: a deployment without\n * the service must still activate the plugin (a missing injected service leaves\n * the whole row `pending`), so the terminal tab degrades instead.\n *\n * The shapes mirror the pinned host package (`dsh-api-terminal-controller`\n * 0.2.0-rc.1, `lib/types/client/{index,model}.d.ts` + `lib/types/types.d.ts`):\n *\n * - `view(sessionId, key, contentId, terminalId?, shellPath?)` returns the\n *   STABLE model for one occurrence (`key` memoizes it; repeating a call is\n *   free) and allocates the terminal eagerly on first call. `contentId` is the\n *   persistence key: the service remembers `(sessionId, contentId) -> host\n *   terminal id` in `localStorage`, so passing the same `contentId` after a\n *   page reload ADOPTS the saved process instead of allocating a new one —\n *   unless an explicit `terminalId` is given, which wins.\n * - `mount()` attaches the DOM lifetime and returns a DETACH callback; the\n *   process survives unmount (only `close()` ends it).\n * - `state.render` is the next screen frame awaiting\n *   {@link HostTerminalView.acknowledge}; the service will not publish the\n *   following frame until it is acknowledged, so the emulator's write callback\n *   is what releases the stream.\n * - `write` / `resize` are refused unless the view is currently `writable`\n *   (the host serializes input across windows per attachment).\n */\nimport type { Context } from '../context-types.ts'\n\n/** A host terminal identity, unique per Session and host lifetime. */\nexport type WebTerminalId = string\n\n/** Host-owned terminal state; process exit never creates a replacement shell. */\nexport interface HostTerminalInfo {\n  readonly id: WebTerminalId\n  readonly title: string\n  /** Initial working directory; a shell's own `cd` does not update it. */\n  readonly cwd: string\n  readonly cols: number\n  readonly rows: number\n  readonly state: 'running' | 'exited' | 'failed'\n  readonly exitCode: number | null\n  readonly error?: string\n}\n\n/** Working directory and limits shared by new and restored terminals. */\nexport interface HostTerminalEnvironment {\n  readonly cwd: string\n  readonly maxInputBytes: number\n  readonly maxCols: number\n  readonly maxRows: number\n  readonly scrollback: number\n}\n\n/**\n * Every attachment begins with a complete bounded screen (the host serializes\n * the emulator's screen), then ordered output; `state` frames only carry\n * metadata. This is why the view REPLAYS `screen` rather than appending it.\n */\nexport type HostTerminalFrame =\n  | { readonly type: 'snapshot'; readonly sequence: number; readonly screen: string; readonly info: HostTerminalInfo }\n  | { readonly type: 'output'; readonly sequence: number; readonly data: string }\n  | { readonly type: 'state'; readonly info: HostTerminalInfo }\n\n/** Product error identifiers the host terminals UI translates. */\nexport type HostTerminalIssue = 'missingTerminal' | 'inputFull' | 'attachmentEnded' | 'invalidOutput' | 'terminalLimit'\n\n/**\n * The two frame kinds that carry screen content. the DOM lifetime is irrelevant to it. */\n  close(): Promise<void>\n}\n\n/** The service slice this plugin consumes. */\nexport interface WebTerminalsFace {\n  view(\n    sessionId: string,\n    key: string,\n    contentId: string,\n    terminalId?: WebTerminalId,\n    shellPath?: string,\n  ): HostTerminalView\n  /**\n   * Save a close intent, release the occurrence immediately and drop the\n   * `(sessionId, contentId)` binding; a service that does not look like the pinned contract reads\n * as absent rather than throwing at the first keystroke.\n * @param ctx - the client context.\n */\nexport function webTerminals(ctx: Context): WebTerminalsFace | undefined {\n  const service = ctx.get('webTerminals') as unknown as Partial<WebTerminalsFace> | undefined\n  if (service === undefined || service === null) return undefined\n  if (typeof service.view !== 'function' || typeof service.close !== 'function') return undefined\n  if (typeof service.recover !== 'function') return undefined\n  return service as WebTerminalsFace\n}\n\n/** Namespace for the plugin's own occurrence key and content identity. */\nconst TERMINAL_NS = 'dsh-better-sidebar:terminal-bottom'\n\n/** The persisted `tab.meta` field identifying ONE terminal tab instance. */\nexport const INSTANCE_FIELD = 'terminalInstance'\n\n/** The persisted `tab.meta` field holding the content-identity generation. */\nconst RUN_FIELD = 'terminalRun'\n\n/**\n * The content identity of the bottom terminal at `run`.\n *\n * The host keys its recovery binding on `(sessionId, contentId)`, so a stable\n * value is what makes a page reload adopt the SAME host terminal instead of\n * allocating a new one. TERMINAL_NS : `${TERMINAL_NS}:${instance}`\n  return run === 0 ? base : `${base}#${run}`\n}\n\n/** The per-tab instance id a tab carries (absent/legacy tabs read as `undefined`). */\nexport function terminalInstanceOf(tab: { meta?: unknown }): string | undefined {\n  const meta = tab.meta !== null && typeof tab.meta === 'object' && !Array.isArray(tab.meta)\n    ? tab.meta as Record<string, unknown>\n    : {}\n  const instance = meta[INSTANCE_FIELD]\n  return typeof instance === 'string' && instance !== '' ? instance : undefined\n}\n\n/** The content-identity generation a tab carries (absent/corrupt reads as 0). */\nexport function terminalRunOf(tab: { meta?: unknown }): number {\n  const meta = tab.meta !== null && typeof tab.meta === 'object' && !Array.isArray(tab.meta)\n    ? tab.meta as Record<string, unknown>\n    : {}\n  const run = meta[RUN_FIELD]\n  return typeof run === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(run) && run >= 0 ? run : 0\n}\n\n/**\n * The `tab.meta` patch that mints the tab's next terminal.\n *\n * The instance has to survive the bump: `patchTab` REPLACES `meta` wholesale,\n * so returning only the run field would drop `terminalInstance` and collapse\n * the tab onto the legacy identity — where every tab that bumped its run lands\n * on the same key (`…terminal-bottom#1`) and the host, which memoizes one view\n * per `(sessionId, key)`, would hand two tabs the SAME shell.       "content": "/**\n * File mutations for the sidebar (the upload route and the tree's renames,\n * deletes and mkdirs).\n *\n * ⚠️ **No workspace containment any more.** The guard was removed at the\n * user's request, so these operations reach whatever the HOST USER can reach.\n * What is still enforced is the SHAPE of a request: the relative upload path\n * is sanitized (absolute paths, '.', '..' and empty segments are refused), a\n * rename/mkdir name must be one path segment, a new FILE's name is additionally\n * checked against the characters and device names Windows cannot store, an\n * existing destination is refused instead of clobbered, and the session\n * workspace root itself is never renamable or removable. Bytes stream from the\n * request body to a uniquely named temp sibling and are renamed into place, so\n * a failed, aborted, or oversized upload never leaves a partial file at the\n * target path.\n *\n * The tree's rename/delete are link-aware: they address the LEXICAL row path\n * (lstat decides), so renaming or deleting a symlink row renames/unlinks the\n * LINK, never its target — matching what the tree row visually names (VS Code\n * semantics). Every mutation invalidates the directory cache of the level(s)\n * it touched.\n */\nimport { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { once } from 'node:events'\nimport { createWriteStream } from 'node:fs'\nimport { access, lstat, mkdir, rename, rm, stat, unlink, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'\nimport { basename, dirname, join } from 'node:path'\nimport { invalidateDirectoryCache, requireAbsolute } from './fs-tree.ts'\nimport { ensureWorkspaceWritePath, resolveTarget } from './path-security.ts'\nimport { encodeText, fileFormatOf, restoreEol } from './text-encoding.ts'\nimport { SidebarError } from './wire.ts'\n\n/**\n * The name SHAPE every file mutation shares: one path segment, no separators,\n * no `.`/`..`. Shared by rename, mkdir and the new-file rule so the three\n * entries refuse the same inputs with the same sentence.\n */\nfunction assertSingleSegmentName(name: string): void {\n  if (name === '' || name === '.' || name === '..' || name.includes('/') || name.includes('\\\\')) {\n    throw new SidebarError('bad-request', 'name must be a single path segment', 400)\n  }\n}\n\n/** Inputs of one upload: the session scope plus the request body stream. */\nexport interface WorkspaceUploadInput {\n  /** The session workspace root (the base of session-relative targets). */\n  cwd: string\n  /** Upload directory chosen by the client — absolute, session-relative, or `~`-relative (#713). */\n  dir: string\n  /** Relative path below `dir` (absolute paths, '.', '..' and empty segments refused). */\n  relativePath: string\n  /** The request body stream (raw bytes). */\n  chunks: AsyncIterable<string | Uint8Array>\n  /** @deprecated IGNORED — containment was removed. Do not pass it. */\n  fence?: boolean\n}\n\n/**\n * Windows refuses a rename with one of these codes when another rename is\n * landing on the same destination at that instant. The refusal says nothing\n * about the destination — it is contention, not a verdict — and it is\n * transient: every refused rename in the measurements below landed on the very\n * next attempt.\n */\nconst RENAME_CONTENTION = new Set(['EPERM', 'EACCES', 'EBUSY'])\n\n/**\n * How many refusals ONE upload absorbs before the failure is reported.\n *\n * The losers of one instant retry into each other, so this has to be a budget\n * rather than a single retry.
